config.section.Selection_Step_01.name: Recolors support :
config.Allow_Recolors.name: Activate recolors support
config.Allow_Recolors.description: Allow for the tilesheets to change color to fit a specific recolor. If disabled will only use the game standard colors, no matter if you are using the automatic selection or the manual override.
config.Use_Alt_Colors.name: Use optional colors
config.Use_Alt_Colors.description: Some recolors (like Starblue or Vibrant Pastoral) offer optional foliage and grass colors during some seasons. Activating this option will use these alternative colors on the tilesheets.
config.section.Selection_Step_02.name: Optionally, disable automatic selection :
config.Manual_Override.name: Manual override
config.Manual_Override.description: Deactivates the automatic detection of recolors, will instead require to manually select one recolor from the following list.
config.section.Selection_Step_03.name: Then select one recolor manually :
config.Blue_Grass.name: Blue Grass
config.Blue_Grass.description: Will force the usage of Blue Grass compatible colors.
config.Earthy_Recolour.name: Earthy Recolour
config.Earthy_Recolour.description: Will force the usage of Earthy Recolour compatible colors.
config.Starblue_Valley.name: Starblue Valley
config.Starblue_Valley.description: Will force the usage of Starblue Valley compatible colors.
config.Vibrant_Pastoral.name: Vibrant Pastoral
config.Vibrant_Pastoral.description: Will force the usage of Vibrant Pastoral compatible colors.
config.Wittily_Named.name: Wittily Named Recolor
config.Wittily_Named.description: Will force the usage of Wittily Named Recolor compatible colors.
config.section.Selection_Step_04.name: Or tinker with more complex recolors :
config.Cotton_Candy.name: --- Cotton Candy Recolor ---
config.Cotton_Candy.description: Will force the usage of Cotton Candy Recolor compatible colors.
config.CC_Grass_Spring.name: Cotton Candy Spring Grass
config.CC_Grass_Summer.name: Cotton Candy Summer Grass
config.CC_Grass_Fall.name: Cotton Candy Fall Grass
config.CC_Dirt_Spring.name: Cotton Candy Spring Dirt
config.CC_Dirt_Summer.name: Cotton Candy Summer Dirt
config.CC_Dirt_Fall.name: Cotton Candy Fall Dirt
config.CC_Snow_Color.name: Cotton Candy Snow Color
config.Universal_Recolors.name: --- Universal Recolors ---
config.Universal_Recolors.description: Will force the usage of Universal Recolors compatible colors.
config.UR_Desaturation.name: Universal Recolors Desaturation
config.UR_Desaturation.description: Select how desaturated colors will be.
config.UR_Hue.name: Universal Recolors Hue
config.UR_Hue.description: Select the level of intensity of the hue shift.
config.section.Selection_Step_05.name: Additional options :
config.Mild_Winter.name: Mild Winter
config.Mild_Winter.description: Will force the usage of Mild Winter compatible tiles during winter. This will TAKE PRECEDENCE over any previously selected recolor during the winter season, no matter if you are using the automatic selection or the manual override.
config.Cave_Fol_Color.name: Cave Foliage Color
config.Cave_Fol_Color.description: Will turn all non-frozen cave foliage green and make the vines brighter.
config.Alt_In_Grass.name: Custom Cave Grass
config.Alt_In_Grass.description: Ensure that for compatible mods (like Waterfall Forest Farms), the grass growing inside of caves will use a custom color.
